source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 24.1, printed pages 215-216.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter aap ko zindagi ke evolution (irtiqa, yaani waqt ke saath aahista aahista tabdeel hona) ka tasawwur mukhtalif scientists ke nazariyat (theories) ke zariye samjhayega. Aap un bare saboot (evidence) ka bhi ghaur se jaiza lenge jin par evolution ka sab se zyada maana hua nazariya qaim hai.

Evolution kisi population (aabadi, yaani ek hi species ke jandaron ka group) ki genetic banawat (allele frequencies, yaani har allele kitni dafa maujood hai) mein ek nasl (generation) se doosri nasl tak hone wali aahista tabdeeli hai. Yeh tabdeeli aakhir mein nayi species bana sakti hai. Shuru mein evolution ke tasawwur ke yeh bunyadi khayalat (speculations) the:

items: Kainaat (universe) aur jandar hamesha apni maujooda shakal mein nahin the;
Aaj ke jandar ek hi waqt mein paida nahin kiye gaye; aur
Yeh nichli (saada) shakal se oonchi (pecheeda) shakal tak beshumaar tabdeeliyon ka nateeja hain.

blocks.text: Evolution jandaron mein farq (variations) aur natural selection (qudrati intikhab) ki wajah se hota hai. Is khayal ke mutabiq faida-mand khasiyaton (beneficial traits) wale jandar agli naslein paida karne ke liye chune jate hain. Doosri taraf nuqsan-deh khasiyaton (disadvantageous traits) wale afraad agli naslein paida nahin kar pate. Is ka nateeja yeh hai ke population mein behtar khasiyaton wale afraad ki percentage barhti jati hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Evolution ka matlab yeh nahin ke ek jandar apni zindagi mein badal jata hai. Badalti population hai: naslon ke saath achhi khasiyaton wale afraad zyada hote jate hain aur kamzor khasiyaton wale kam.

blocks.prompt: Jadeed tareef (definition) ke mutabiq jab koi population evolve hoti hai to us mein kya badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Us ki genetic banawat, yaani naslon ke saath alleles ki frequency (har allele kitna aam hai) badalti hai. Yeh tabdeeli aakhir mein nayi species bana sakti hai.

items: Evolution: population ki genetic banawat (allele frequencies) mein naslon ke saath aahista tabdeeli; is se nayi species ban sakti hai.
Shuru ke khayalat: kainaat aur jandar hamesha aise nahin the, sab ek saath paida nahin hue, aur saade se pecheeda tak tabdeeliyan hui.
Evolution variations aur natural selection se hota hai: achhi khasiyaton wale zyada nasl barhate hain.
